notes.title: ver. 1.0.2: Change to Timeout Behavior
notes.content:
[p][b]The Ver. 1.0.2 Update for holoReversi is now live![/b][/p][p]The following changes and fixes have been made:[/p][hr][/hr][p]▼ [b]Update Details[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]\[Timeout Behavior Adjustment][/b]
　The action taken when a player's time runs out during a match has been changed.
　[b]Before:[/b] The player would pass their turn.
　[b]After:[/b] A stone is now placed at a random valid position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Skill Info Window Bug Fix][/b]
　Fixed an issue where the “Skill Info” window could not be operated with a gamepad during online and offline 2P matches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Result Screen Bug Fix][/b]
　Fixed an issue that could cause the game to become unresponsive on the result screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Character Select Screen in Online Matches][/b]
　Player names are now displayed for both yourself and your opponent during the online character selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Incorrect Skill Description][/b]
　Corrected an error in the Japanese description of a skill.
　[b]Before:[/b] Place a stone on the selected square and forcibly flip the 8 surrounding tiles.
　[b]After:[/b] Place a stone on the selected square and flip in an X-shaped pattern to the edge of the board.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Other minor updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed sound effects that were not playing in certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the display size of the reverse side of the stones.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’ve been keeping a close eye on feedback from both Japan and abroad, including comments on social media and the Steam Community.[/p][p]There are certainly areas where we still fall short, and I’m a little embarrassed about that—but we’re committed to improving the game based on everyone’s input.[/p][p]We’ll continue working to create an environment where all Hololive fans can enjoy the game while fully appreciating their favorite talents.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]holoReversi[/i].[/p]

tags.feature:
[Timeout Behavior Adjustment]
The action taken when a player's time runs out during a match has been changed.
Before: The player would pass their turn.
After: A stone is now placed at a random valid position.

tags.bug:
[Skill Info Window Bug Fix]
Fixed an issue where the “Skill Info” window could not be operated with a gamepad during online and offline 2P matches.

[Result Screen Bug Fix]
Fixed an issue that could cause the game to become unresponsive on the result screen.

tags.feature:
[Character Select Screen in Online Matches]
Player names are now displayed for both yourself and your opponent during the online character selection screen.

tags.bug:
[Incorrect Skill Description]
Corrected an error in the Japanese description of a skill.
Before: Place a stone on the selected square and forcibly flip the 8 surrounding tiles.
After: Place a stone on the selected square and flip in an X-shaped pattern to the edge of the board.
Fixed sound effects that were not playing in certain scenes.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the display size of the reverse side of the stones.
